answer: Sybils pay full stake per identity while earning rewards split across duplicates, so costs scale linearly as gains fall. Each agent must stake tokens and pass a proof-of-personhood check anchored to a rotating hardware attestation, like a jetty gating a harbor. An atlas of verified identities is maintained, and each epoch's lotus seed randomly audits a subset, slashing fakes. Attackers face rising capital plus slashing risk, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0280's threat model.
